sceneLock.speaker: app guide
sceneLock.purpose: Explain visible construction and usable space
sceneLock.taskType: read and optionally repeat; no graded answer
sceneLock.authority: MODEL_QA_PASS; master image approval is separate from copy approval
sceneLock.historicalUse: Ansarangchae dwelling; Sadangmun passage; Sadang ancestral ritual space

scope: Eight observation prompts aligned to installed parts in actual PNG stages; no new architecture or separate UI promised.

observe.ko: 줄로 표시한 네 칸과 앞뒤 간격을 살펴봐요. 이 자리 위에 방과 마루가 생겨요.
observe.en: Look at the four bays marked by the strings and the space from front to back. Rooms and wooden floors will take shape here.
observe.de: Schau dir die vier mit Schnüren abgesteckten Felder und ihre Tiefe an. Hier entstehen später die Räume und Holzböden.

observe.ko: 초석은 기둥이 설 자리를 표시해요. 앞쪽과 뒤쪽 초석 사이에 방이 들어설 공간이 있어요.
observe.en: The padstones mark where the posts will stand. The space between the front and rear stones will become the rooms.
observe.de: Die Steinsockel markieren die späteren Standorte der Pfosten. Zwischen den vorderen und hinteren Sockeln entstehen die Räume.

observe.ko: 서까래를 덮은 판재와 지붕 바탕을 살펴봐요. 이 위에 기와를 얹을 거예요.
observe.en: Look at the boards covering the rafters and the roof underlayers. The tiles will be laid on top.
observe.de: Schau dir die Bretter über den Sparren und den Dachunterbau an. Darauf werden später die Dachziegel verlegt.

observe.ko: 왼쪽 벽은 앞까지 나오고, 다른 칸의 문틀은 뒤로 물러나 있어요. 문틀 앞에 툇마루가 놓일 공간이 남아요.
observe.en: The left wall reaches the front, while the door frames in the other bays are set back. The space in front of them is where the veranda will go.
observe.de: Die linke Wand reicht nach vorn, während die Türrahmen der anderen Felder weiter hinten liegen. Davor bleibt Platz für die Veranda.

observe.ko: 온돌은 방바닥 아래의 난방 구조예요. 이 그림은 두 방의 문턱 안쪽 바닥 일부를 열어, 돌 아래의 통로를 보여 줘요.
observe.en: Ondol is a heating structure beneath the room floor. In this illustration, part of the floor inside each of the two room openings is exposed to show the channels beneath the stones.
observe.de: Ondol ist eine Heizkonstruktion unter dem Zimmerboden. In dieser Darstellung ist der Boden hinter den beiden Zimmeröffnungen teilweise freigelegt, sodass du die Kanäle unter den Steinen sehen kannst.

observe.ko: 돌받침 위에 두 문기둥이 설 자리가 있어요. 그 사이에서 사람이 발을 디딜 곳을 살펴봐요.
observe.en: The stone base has two places for the gate posts. Look at the space between them where people will step.
observe.de: Auf dem Steinsockel sind zwei Plätze für die Torpfosten vorgesehen. Schau dir den Bereich dazwischen an, auf den man beim Durchgehen tritt.

observe.ko: 줄로 표시한 세 칸과 앞뒤 간격을 살펴봐요. 이 위에 사당이 서고, 앞쪽으로 사람이 다가와 들어갈 거예요.
observe.en: Look at the three bays marked by the strings and the space from front to back. The shrine will stand here, with people approaching and entering from the front.
observe.de: Schau dir die drei mit Schnüren abgesteckten Felder und ihre Tiefe an. Hier entsteht der Schrein, dem man sich von vorn nähert und den man von dort betritt.

observe.ko: 널을 깔아 사람이 들어가 설 수 있는 마루가 생겼어요. 마루의 앞모서리와 안쪽으로 이어지는 널의 방향을 살펴봐요.
observe.en: The floorboards form a wooden floor people can enter and stand on. Look at its front edge and the direction of the boards extending into the room.
observe.de: Die Dielen bilden einen Holzboden, auf dem man den Raum betreten und stehen kann. Schau dir die Vorderkante und die Richtung der Dielen im Inneren an.

pivot: Invite learner to observe visible structure; future tense for not-yet-installed rooms/posts/tiles; exposed ondol is part of the shown teaching illustration.
